title: Citi's Virtual Accounts
description: Citi's global network can support virtual accounts in a multitude of currencies and countries. Virtual accounts are linked to a physical account to help clients meet their unique banking needs.   View other Citi videos: http://www.youtube.com/citi Read our Blog: http://blog.citigroup.com Like us on Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/citi Follow us on Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/citi Follow us on LinkedIn: http://www.linkedin.com/company/citi Follow us on Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/citi Follow us on Google+: http://www.google.com/+citi

asr.full_text: Companies with multiple businesses or global operations often maintain bank accounts per country, business line, and currency. Each physical account incurs costs and maintaining numerous accounts can fragment liquidity, increase FX exposure, and heighten the risk of fraud. Corporations can reduce the costs and complexity of banking by rationalizing their physical account structure. company often still require individual accounts to segregate business activites. With Citi's virtual accounts solution a company can maintain a single physical account while subdividing it into numerous VRTUAL ACCOUNTS which can be setup by individual payer, legal entity, business unit, or other user group. Virtual account users can initiate and receive transactions, view balances and generate statements at the virtual account level. Money only flows to and from the physical account. The balances in the virtual accounts are only a representative view. With a centralized view of real-time cash positions, Treasurers can optimise liquidity and make more informed funding decisions When Citi implemented a Virtual Account solution for a multinational corporation, the client wanted to rationalise their physical account structure, without impacting their existing supply chain. Citi seamlessly converted all but one of the client's physical accounts into virtual accounts, with each virtual account retaining the physical account number from which it was converted. By implementing virtual accounts with Citi, the corporation benefited from fewer physical accounts, centralized liquidity and streamlined reconciliation. Meanwhile, the corporation's remitters and beneficiaries were able to proceed with business as usual. Citi's global network can support virtual accounts in a multitude of currencies to help clients meet their unique banking needs. Citi's virtual account solution can help companies around the world achieve centralization, simplification and cost efficiency. To find out how your company can benefit from Citi's Virtual Account solution, please contact your Citi representative.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is a Citi-branded business banking explainer about using virtual accounts to organize transactions, balances, and statements. It presents ordinary product benefits and directs interested companies to contact a Citi representative, without specifying investment returns or asking viewers to submit credentials or send money. A closing disclaimer further frames it as corporate educational content.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content explains an operational banking technology: a company can subdivide a physical account into virtual accounts, whose users can handle transactions and view account-level balances and statements.
